clips.end_words: as you exhale, it goes in
clips.send: A parent sends this to the friend who says they're too busy to breathe right - quiet awe at a fix that costs zero extra minutes in the day.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's simple fix for a stressed-out body: write one word, "breathe," on a card and tape it to your fridge, your mirror, your car - anywhere you'll see it 20 times a day.

Each time you see it, do this: put your attention two inches below your belly button, relax your stomach, relax your face, and breathe in and out through your nose only.

He says most people breathe from the chest all day without ever noticing it.

Where would you put your card first - the fridge, the mirror, or the car?

#kevintrudeau #breathing #stressrelief #selfcare #wellness #healthtruth

clips.send: A friend sends this to whoever just took their third pill of the week - anger at hearing a drug company offered Kevin millions to push one.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he's been called by major pharmaceutical companies more than once, offering him millions of dollars to endorse their drugs.

His answer was always the same: he doesn't take the drug. He says healthy people don't buy drugs, and that's exactly why, in his view, the industry has no reason to want people breathing - or living - in a way that keeps them well.

He wrote the best-selling natural health book of all time telling people they don't need the pill in the first place.

What would you turn down millions to avoid promoting?

#kevintrudeau #pharma #naturalhealth #wholefood #healthtruth #wbdaily
